title: Central High and the Center School: Dicky Wells, Jonah Jones and friends
summary: All the future musicians attended Central High and gathered at Miss Allen's Center School. Humes remembers them as funny, ordinary schoolmates, and she and Dance try and fail to recall the name of Jonah Jones's brother-in-law and wife.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, we'll think of it. Well, I'll tell you what I think would be interesting to talk about is the school and the musicians at the school. Are they still around today?
Oh yes,
What school was it Helen?
It wasn't a school. We went to Central High School.
Oh, I see. All of you went to Central High School?
Yeah, we all went to Central High. And then, but I mean this was Miss Bess Allen's Center School where we all got together.
Got together and played. But did you actually remember, I mean was Dicky Wells or Jonah (Jones), or anybody right in your class at High School? Do you actually remember them at school?
Yeah, I remember them.
